work.abstract_text: We extend Korea Superintelligence Labs' (2026) affirmative answer to Aliabadi's Problem 7.6 (A nonabelian twist on differences of bijections, arXiv:2605.16478v2, Section 7, page 17) by giving exact two-letter and abelian-subgroup criteria, the latter answering Problem 7.4. For a finite group G of order n and distinct u,v, a multiset with k copies of v and n-k copies of u is quotient-realizable exactly when d=ord(u^-1 v) divides k; the number of realizing permutations is binomial(n/d,k/d). We give product-one obstructions in every nonabelian dihedral group, every dicyclic group of order at least eight, and A4. Hall's theorem (1952) supplies abelian sufficiency, the two-diagonal permanent formula of De Poi et al. (2018) supplies the enumeration antecedent, and the Erdős–Ginzburg–Ziv theorem (1961) supplies the block decomposition.

work.title: Aliabadi's Problems 7.4 and 7.6: Two-letter and subgroup extensions of Korea Superintelligence Labs (2026) (arXiv:2605.16478v2, Section 7, page 17)
